sv.title: MFF:s lånekarusell – så har det gått för spelarna
sv.summary: Malmö FF har skickat en uppsjö av spelare på lån under säsongen som gått. En del med gott utfall. Andra har haft det tufft i en ny miljö. Sydsvenskan har gått igenom situationen.

en.title: MFF's loan carousel – how the players have fared
en.summary: Malmö FF has sent a host of players on loan during the season that is ending. Some with good results. Others have struggled in a new environment. Sydsvenskan has reviewed the situation.
